issue_request: FHIR-8197 was a Published/Persuasive 2015 May QICore/FHIR-core profiles ballot issue asking profile snapshot and differential tables to show the bound value set and binding strength instead of confusing binding-name links.
initial_application: Jira comments say the tooling work was complete by June 2015.
